name: schema-version
description: If schema version is not equal to current guake version, the schema file is regenerated and this flag is set to the current guake version.

name: debug-mode
description: When debug mode is enabled, logs are printed in the standard output where Guake as been launched

name: mouse-display
description: Appear on the mouse display. This overrides any setting in display_n.

name: display-n
description: Display to appear on if the  mouse_display option is not set. If this is set to an invalid value (as in the case of removing a screen from a system), the invalid value is automatically updated to the current primary screen.

name: default-shell
description: Path to the default shell. Set to empty to use default user shell. If invalid path is set here, guake will fallback to user shell.

name: restore-tabs-startup
description: If true, when guake startup, it will restore tabs from previous session

name: restore-tabs-notify
description: If true, when guake restored the tabs, it will notify the user that the tabs has been restored

name: save-tabs-when-changed
summary: Automatically save tabs session when changed
description: If true, when tabs has changed (add / delete ...etc.), it will automatically saved the tabs session

name: load-guake-yml
description: If true, when a change in the cwd is detected settings are changed based on the content of the file `cwd`/.guake.yml

name: use-login-shell
description: If true, the commands in terminal will be executed in a login shell.

name: use-trayicon
description: When true tray is visible.

name: workspace-specific-tab-sets
description: When true, each workspace gets their own set of tabs.

name: use-popup
description: When true, popup notifications will be shown when Guake starts.

name: prompt-on-quit
description: Ask for confirmation when quitting Guake.

name: prompt-on-close-tab
description: 0: Never 1: If process is running 2: Always.  Also prompts on quit.

name: search-engine
summary: Search engine to use when using web search
description: Search engine to use

name: custom-search-engine
summary: Search engine to use when using web search
description: Custom search engine url to use

name: window-ontop
description: Makes guake window be on top of all other windows in the desktop.

name: window-refocus
description: Refocus window instead of closing.

name: tab-ontop
description: Makes tab bar on top of the Guake window. Per default, tabs appear below the terminal. Setting this to True will move the tab on top of the terminal. Requires a restart.

name: new-tab-after
summary: New tabs appear after the current tab.
description: Makes new tabs appear after the currently selected tab, instead of at the end.

name: window-losefocus
summary: Determine if guake hides on lose focus.
description: If this property is set as true, guake will be hidden when the main window lose the focus (when Alt+Tab be pressed for example).

name: lazy-losefocus
description: Momentarily delay hiding Guake when focus is lost and don't hide if focus is returned quickly, like when switching desktops or turning on certain IMEs.

name: window-tabbar
description: When true, the tab bar is visible.

name: fullscreen-hide-tabbar
description: When true, the tab bar will hide when is in fullscreen

name: hide-tabs-if-one-tab
summary: Hide tab bar if there is only one tab
description: When true, the tab bar will hide when there is only one tab

name: quick-open-enable
description: If this property is set as true, guake will open a text editor when the user does a Ctrl+Click on a filename printed in the terminal.

name: quick-open-command-line
summary: Command line pattern to start a editor.
description: This property gives the command line to execute when doing a Quick Open. You can enter the following python string pattern in it: '%(file_path)s' will be replaced with the full path to the captured filename, '%(line_number)s' will be replaced by the line number if found (set to the empty string otherwise).

name: quick-open-in-current-terminal
summary: Quick open the file in the current terminal.
description: If this property is set as true, guake will use the current terminal to execute the Quick open feature. Use if you want to inherit your terminal environment in your text editor

name: startup-script
summary: Startup script to execute when guake starts
description: This property allows you to execute a startup bash script each time guake starts. You can configure your initial tab settings within this script. Please see the command line argument of guake ('guake --help') for complete help.

name: start-fullscreen
description: When true, the program will start in fullscreen mode.

name: start-at-login
description: When true, the program will start upon GNOME login.

name: use-audible-bell
description: If true, the system alert sound will be played on a bell character.

name: display-tab-activity
description: If true, the title of a background tab is highlighted when its terminal produces output, until the tab is selected.

name: tab-activity-new-tab-grace
summary: Activity grace period for new tabs
description: Number of seconds during which activity is ignored on a newly created tab, to avoid highlighting it because of its initial shell prompt.

name: tab-activity-focus-loss-grace
summary: Activity grace period after losing focus
description: Number of seconds during which activity is ignored on a tab right after it loses focus.

name: window-width
description: Percent of the screen that will be used by guake terminal horizontally.

name: window-height
description: Percent of the screen that will be used by guake terminal vertically.

name: window-horizontal-displacement
description: Displace the window horizontally by a given amount of pixels.

name: window-vertical-displacement
description: Displace the window vertically by a given amount of pixels.

name: window-halignment
description: Place Guake at: 0: center, 1: left, 2: right

name: window-valignment
description: Place Guake at: 0: top, 1: bottom

name: background-image-file
description: When setup, the selected background image will show on guake

name: background-image-layout-mode
description: To select which layout mode want to use for background image.

name: use-scrollbar
description: When true, scrollbar is visible.

name: history-size
description: The number of scrollback lines to save in history.

name: infinite-history
description: Scrollback lines in history is infinite

name: scroll-output
description: If true, whenever there is new output in the terminal, it will scroll to the bottom.

name: scroll-keystroke
description: If true and a key is pressed, the terminal is scrolled to the bottom.

name: use-default-font
description: If true, Guake will use the GNOME monospace default font.

name: use-vte-titles
summary: Use terminal titles for tab naming
description: Any terminal program can set the terminal's title via special escape sequences. Some shells (e.g. bash) display user's prompt there (though you can adjust that to any arbitrary text in bashrc or similar) and update it automatically as the prompt changes. So you can have easy automatically updating meaningful tab titles with this option turned on.

name: set-window-title
summary: Set window title to current tab name
description: If true, Guake will update its window title from the current tab name. It is useful when you work with applications that use windows title, (keepass, automatic time tracker apps)

name: compat-backspace
description: Defines the behavior of backspace key.

name: compat-delete
description: Defines the behavior of delete key.

name: word-chars
summary: Characters that are considered "part of a word"
description: When selecting text by word, sequences of these characters are considered single words. Ranges can be given as "A-Z". Literal hyphen (not expressing a range) should be the first character given.

name: toolbar-visible-in-fullscreen
summary: If the tabs bar must be visible in fullscreen
description: Set it as false to enjoy guake's fullscreen.

name: focus-if-open
summary: Give focus to guake if tab is opened (OBSOLETE).
description: If the guake window is out of focus but open, enabling this will give it back the focus instead of closing the window.

name: custom-command-file
summary: Path to the default custom command json file.
description: Path to the default custom command json file. If is blank or the json file is not in a proper format the terminal context menu will be built without custom commands. If the file is a valid json with recognized structure theterminak context menu will be built with the commands read inside.

name: open-tab-cwd
summary: Open new tab in the current working directory
description: Open new tab in the current working directory

name: max-tab-name-length
description: #TODO PORT max-tab-name-length

name: display-tab-names
description: Controls how the tab names are displayed. 0: Full Path, 1: Abbreviated Path, 2: Only display the last segment of the path

name: gtk-use-system-default-theme
summary: Use system default theme for GTK
description: Prefer the system default theme

name: gtk-theme-name
description: Name of the GTK theme to apply on Guake. If set to an empty string, let GTK use the default system theme

name: gtk-prefer-dark-theme
description: Prefer the dark theme version of the theme if available

name: tab-close-buttons
description: Show close buttons next to tab titles

name: copy-on-select
description: Copy the selected text.

name: cursor-blink-mode
summary: Cursor blink mode of the terminal
description: Controls the blink mode of the cursor in the terminals. 0: Follow GTK+ setting, 1: Blink on, 2: Blink off

name: cursor-shape
description: Controls the shape of the cursor in the terminals. 0: Block, 1: I-Beam, 2: Underline

name: style
description: Font face and size that will be used in terminal.

name: palette
description: Color scheme that will be used in terminal.

name: palette-name
description: Color scheme name that will be used in terminal.

name: allow-bold
summary: Allow displaying bold font in Guake terminal.
description: When allow_bold is disabled, any text in Guake terminal intended to print as bold text will be instead rendered as normal text.

name: bold-is-bright
summary: Use bright colors for bold text
description: If true, text from the first 8 colors that is formatted as bold will also be switched to its bright variant (VTE >=0.52).

name: cell-height-scale
summary: Set terminal's cell height scale to `scale` (VTE >= 0.52)
description: This can be used to increase the line spacing. (The font's height is not affected.) Valid values go from 1.0 (default) to 2.0 ("double spacing").

name: cell-width-scale
summary: Set terminal's cell width scale to `scale` (VTE >= 0.52)
description: This can be used to increase the letter spacing. (The font's width is not affected.) Valid values go from 1.0 (default) to 2.0 ("double spacing").

name: transparency
description: Alpha that will be applied to the terminal background.

name: show-hide
description: Global keybinding to allow user call guake from each place after it's opened without clicks.

name: show-focus
summary: Keybinding to show and focus guake.
description: Global keybinding to allow user call guake from each place after it's opened without clicks.

name: search-terminal
description: Show search box to search text inside the terminal

name: quit
description: Quit Guake.

name: new-tab
description: Calls the function to add a new tab in guake window.

name: new-tab-home
summary: Add a new tab in home directory.
description: Calls the function to add a new home directory tab in guake window.

name: new-tab-cwd
summary: Add a new tab in current directory.
description: Calls the function to add a new tab in guake window, in the same directory as the current tab.

name: close-tab
description: Accelerator to active function that closes the current selected tab.

name: search-on-web
summary: Search current selected text on the web
description: Accelerator to active function that search on the web the current selected text on the terminal.

name: open-link-under-terminal-cursor
description: Accelerator to active function that opens the link (URL) under the current terminal cursor.

name: move-tab-left
description: Move the current tab to the left

name: move-tab-right
description: Move the current tab to the right

name: previous-tab
description: Shows the previous tab.

name: next-tab
description: Shows the next tab.

name: previous-tab-alt
description: Alternate shortcut to show the previous tab.

name: next-tab-alt
description: Alternate shortcut to show the next tab.

name: switch-tab1
description: Switch to the first tab.

name: switch-tab2
description: Switch to the second tab.

name: switch-tab3
description: Switch to the third tab.

name: switch-tab4
description: Switch to the fourth tab.

name: switch-tab5
description: Switch to the fifth tab.

name: switch-tab6
description: Switch to the sixth tab.

name: switch-tab7
description: Switch to the seventh tab.

name: switch-tab8
description: Switch to the eighth tab.

name: switch-tab9
description: Switch to the ninth tab.

name: switch-tab10
description: Switch to the tenth tab.

name: rename-current-tab
description: Shows a dialog to rename the current tab.

name: zoom-in
description: Increase the font size of the terminals.

name: zoom-in-alt
description: Additional shortcut for zooming in.

name: zoom-out
description: Decrease the font size of the terminals.

name: increase-height
description: Increase the screen height.

name: decrease-height
description: Decrease the screen height.

name: increase-transparency
description: Increase the terminal transparency.

name: decrease-transparency
description: Decrease the terminal transparency.

name: clipboard-copy
description: Copy the clipboard content.

name: clipboard-paste
description: Paste the clipboard content.

name: select-all
description: Select all contents of the currently active terminal.

name: toggle-fullscreen
description: Toggle main guake window fullscreen.

name: toggle-hide-on-lose-focus
description: Toggle whether guake will hide when it loses focus.

name: reset-terminal
description: Reset terminal

name: toggle-transparency
description: Toggle the terminal transparency from the actual level to 100% and vice versa.

name: switch-tab-last
description: Switch to the last tab.

name: split-tab-vertical
description: Split tab vertical.

name: split-tab-horizontal
description: Split tab horizontal.

name: close-terminal
description: Close the currently focused terminal.

name: focus-terminal-up
description: Focus terminal above.

name: focus-terminal-down
description: Focus terminal below.

name: focus-terminal-right
description: Focus terminal on the right.

name: focus-terminal-left
description: Focus terminal on the left.

name: move-terminal-split-up
summary: Move the terminal split handle up.
description: Move the terminal split handle up.

name: move-terminal-split-down
summary: Move the terminal split handle down.
description: Move the terminal split handle down.

name: move-terminal-split-left
summary: Move the terminal split handle left.
description: Move the terminal split handle left.
